extraction.Name: James Roberts
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 22, 1921 by Richard Jones
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged and sold via sheriff's deed
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Winner State Bank for $1,000 covering the southwest quarter; mortgage assigned to Catherine McCullough; sheriff's deed issued in 1925 conveying to Catherine McCullough the southwest quarter
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: There is tax certificate No. 3663 issued in 1920 against other quarter. Subsequent taxes are unpaid.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739658 issued; The South half of section 13, township 42, range 29; receipt for patent signed by the allottee April 5, 1920; mortgage dated April 12, 1921 for $1,000 executed in favor of the Winner State Bank covered the southwest quarter; mortgage was assigned to Catherine McCullough; sheriff's deed for this tract issued in 1925 conveying the southwest quarter to Catherine McCullough; tax certificate No. 3663 issued in 1920 against other quarter; subsequent taxes unpaid; records viewed February 1929
